# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
The night's one big lesson plus the session's smaller ones, each with its
cost, so the day run does not pay twice:

1. THE LAUNCH DIED WITH THE FOUNDER ASLEEP. Everything was armed by 00:30;
   the one remaining step was a line only he could run, and he was gone. Cost:
   the whole night window. Rule: founder-hand steps are surfaced at hour zero
   while he is at the keyboard, or the plan assumes attended execution.
2. Grant windows expire on schedule (07:00). Grant and go must travel
   together. The expiry firing on an unused grant is the brake working.
3. Editing the tree mid-gate cost a full 17-minute re-run: the suite refuses
   a moving tree, correctly. Hands off during test_all.py.
4. The docs gate refused a dated plan with no status line. Every dated
   document opens with Status: CURRENT or a historical marker.
5. Slop-gate caught two control re-derivations (grepping STATE.md for
   fences, raw sqlite on the store). Ask the control: bm_stall, detect, the
   store CLI, the store API.
6. The scope hook named nine undeclared paths at close because the write
   scope was claimed AFTER writing. Claim files first, under the derived
   bm1-... label the hook prints, not the harness UUID.
7. Store lifecycle refuses skips (ready to blocked needs active between);
   priority vocabulary is critical/high/medium/low, numbers sort last; the
   relay packet orders next actions by that vocabulary.
8. The harness classifier refused a self-raised spend ceiling and a
   bypass-permissions launch. Both correct. The founder's explicit in-chat
   order unblocked the first; the second stays his hand forever.
9. The board artifact's old URL was found dead; the live one is recorded in
   PROJECT.md and updates only via the Artifact tool with that url passed.
10. M11's prose-only closure resurfaced as a confirmed contradiction. Code
    plus a pinned regression test, or it is not closed.
<!-- bm-human:end -->
